description: TPO 36/12 T2 Lime - Fell and grind (summary)
decision_conditions:
Consent is refused for the following works: T2 Lime - Fell and grind
The tree displays no evidence of physiological decline, structural defect, or pathogenic dysfunction that would warrant removal on safety grounds. The stated rationale of established vehicular access is a private convenience and not in the interest of public amenity. This tree is a high value specimen and its loss on this basis is not commensurate to the harm and impact that would be caused to the wider visual amenity. Alternative solutions exist for the provision of electric vehicle charging that do not involve the irrevocable loss of trees. On this basis, the works requested are refused consent and it is recommended that alternative solutions are sought for the provision of electric vehicle charging (i.e. kerbside charging using a cable protector, lamp-column charging, etc…)
